new_claims.statement: At spectral scale L, any invertible original-coordinate 2x2 principal block with sigma_min>=L/64 pays the full ambient form by ||p_Q||inf<619/L; definite blocks pay <202/L.
For b=s1(B)/L, epsilon=sigma_min(B)/L, nu=||N||F/L, the rank-free first-compound receiver gives 15.829(b epsilon^2 nu)^(-1/4)L^-1, so the 619/L benchmark is paid when b epsilon^2 nu>=4.28e-7.

A Hadamard family has exact spectrum {epsilon+2/epsilon,-(epsilon+2/epsilon),1}, robust arm areas one, exact Schur match N=0, and for epsilon<1/64 with large enough m every physical 2x2 pair lies below the gate; fixed-source Theorem F still gives continuous density <=12(epsilon+2/epsilon)^(-2/3).
